svg.title: ToMoBAR capabilities at a glance
svg.desc: Six panels summarise acquisition geometry and backends, direct and iterative reconstruction, LS/PWLS/SWLS data models, six native regularisers, translation alignment and geometry inspection, and energy monitoring with solver continuation. The data-model illustration shows Gaussian and Poisson distributions. The iterative illustration shows update vectors on a schematic two-dimensional objective field approaching its global minimum. CUDA is required for reconstruction. USFFT has method and geometry restrictions.
svg.text: Flexible geometry, GPU reconstruction and regularisation

g.title: Iterative optimisation
g.desc: Contours of a schematic two-dimensional objective field. Successive update vectors approach the global minimum at the centre.

g.title: Gaussian and Poisson models
g.desc: A continuous symmetric Gaussian probability density and a discrete, right-skewed Poisson probability mass function, shown schematically on separate axes.
